sources.summary: Tech company Light has released a clamshell version of its popular minimalist phone, combining contemporary dumbphone functionality with retro appeal. A follow-up to 2025's all-black Light Phone 3, the Light Flip comes in six colours and runs Light's intentionally stripped-back LightOS operating system, which is devoid of social media, games and other common distractions.
